cerc-2007.notes: QOJ letters its ten problems A-J (A Strange Billboard, B Phone Cell, C Hexagonal Parcels, D Key Task, E Gates of Logic, F Weird Numbers, G Rectangular Polygons, H Reaux! Sham! Beaux!, I Robotic Sort, J Rough Water Level); the catalogue uses letters B,C,H,K,L,N,R,S,W, lacks Rectangular Polygons, and names W 'Tough Water Level' where QOJ has 'Rough Water Level'.
